purpose: Frozen held-out test set for RL decisions. Scores only: never read its prompts, responses or failures, never tune on it, never train on it. A change counts only if dev suites and this set both improve.

sub80.purpose: Per-checkpoint RL evaluation subset: a full held-out run costs ~10 h of 5090 time per checkpoint. Same rules as the full set.
sub80.method: random.Random(80).sample of 16 task indexes per kind (id prefix t1..t5), in file order; chosen 2026-09-30 before any RL checkpoint was scored
